اخترطوا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَرَطُوا (iḵtaraṭū) /ix.ta.ra.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# اُخْتُرِطُوا (uḵturiṭū) /ux.tu.ri.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# اِخْتَرِطُوا (iḵtariṭū) /ix.ta.ri.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
